# Outbound Freight Staging and Loading Work Order
Shift: Morning Dock Operations | Date: 03/14/2026

## Order Details
- Order Reference: WO-88421
- Lead Handler: Walter Rowland
- Material Handlers Assigned: Leah Sandoval, Hannah Sato
- Facility: Riverbend Distribution Center, Bay 14
- Destination: Metro Logistics Hub, Columbus, OH

## Assigned Material Manifest
| Pallet ID | Commodity Description | Unit Count | Unit Weight (lb) | Total Weight (lb) | Handling Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PLT-101 | Industrial Fasteners (Grade 8) | 40 cartons | 45 | 1,800 | Heavy; use sit-down forklift |
| PLT-102 | Electrical Conduit Fittings | 30 cartons | 28 | 840 | Standard manual pallet jack |
| PLT-103 | Hydraulic Seal Assemblies | 50 cases | 16 | 800 | Fragile; tier-stack limit 3 |
| PLT-104 | Pneumatic Valve Regulators | 25 cartons | 32 | 800 | Keep dry; wrap before staging |

## Equipment Requisition and Staging Directives
- Retrieve one 4,000-lb capacity electric sit-down forklift from Charging Station 4 for heavy skid staging.
- Utilize manual pallet jack MPJ-08 for all skids weighing less than 1,000 lb.
- Transfer PLT-101 and PLT-102 directly to Staging Lane C-4 by 09:30.
- Stageworks operator must wear standard PPE: high-visibility vest and cut-resistant gloves.
- Secure all staged skids using 80-gauge poly stretch wrap prior to trailer transfer.
- Stage PLT-104 which weighs 1,200 lb in Lane C-5 for inspection before loading.
- Final trailer loading into Trailer TL-409 commences at 10:45 under Walter Rowland's supervision.

errors.quote: Stageworks operator must wear standard PPE: high-visibility vest and cut-resistant gloves.
errors.explanation: OSHA warehouse and dock safety standards require steel-toe or safety-toe protective footwear when handling and moving freight pallets, which is missing from the required PPE line.
errors.fix: Stageworks operator must wear standard PPE: steel-toe boots, high-visibility vest and cut-resistant gloves.

errors.quote: Stage PLT-104 which weighs 1,200 lb in Lane C-5 for inspection before loading.
errors.explanation: The manifest table lists PLT-104 as having 25 cartons at 32 lb each, giving a total weight of 800 lb, not 1,200 lb.
errors.fix: Stage PLT-104 which weighs 800 lb in Lane C-5 for inspection before loading.
